Answer: 0  
Excuse: Expecting a 22-year-old adult to cancel his personal plans and serve as a full-time caregiver for his younger sister for an entire month, without compensation or consideration for his autonomy, is unreasonable and morally unacceptable. While family support is important, it should not override an adult child’s right to personal freedom and independence. The parent has a responsibility to make reasonable childcare arrangements, such as hiring a babysitter or seeking other family help, rather than imposing this burden unilaterally.
